observation: Add keyboard shortcuts for accepting and declining incoming calls ### Is your feature request related to a problem? title: Erratic touchpad scrolling since recent update (Touchpad only, mouse is fine)
observation: Erratic touchpad scrolling since recent update (Touchpad only, mouse is fine) ### Steps to reproduce 1. Scroll any chat / chat list, using the laptop touchpad. ### Expected behaviour Touchpad scrolling should be smooth, linear, and predictable. Scrolling down should move the viewport down, and kinetic scrolling should decay smoothly in the same direction without sudden jumps or direction reversals. ### Actual behaviour Touchpad scrolling is completely broken: - Scrolling causes the chat to jump back in the opposite direction (rubber-banding) or fly randomly into the history, or jumps excessively.. - The issue occurs ONLY when using the touchpad. title: Remove the "Share Contact" Menu
observation: Remove the "Share Contact" Menu If people really need to share the phone number and name of someone they know, they can easily write or copy/paste it. There is no real need for that menu. But the existence of this menu allows for illicit spying bots such as FunStat @JasoousBot to gather people's private information by preying upon stupid people aound them who would thoughtlessly click on a contact and share everything. Adding "Are you sure?" would not fix stupid clicks either.

title: Add Option to Stop Secondary Video Feed Popup from Appearing
observation: Add Option to Stop Secondary Video Feed Popup from Appearing Hi, I use the Flatpak version of the Jitsi desktop application and overall it's excellent. However, I am facing a persistent issue with my dual monitor setup. I like to keep Jitsi in full-screen mode on my secondary monitor. However, when I move my mouse back to the primary monitor to do other tasks, a smaller second video window with the same feed as the call on the secondary monitor appears. I close it, but it keeps reappearing, which is quite frustrating. I have looked through the settings but haven't found an option to turn this behavior off. It would be very helpful if there were a setting to toggle this feature, especially for users with a dual monitor setup who prefer not to have this pop-up window. Please consider adding this option. Thank you for the work you do!
